title: scenarios grader: asked-back:asks false-fails a Chinese ask-back whose request phrase (请确认) follows a comma and that has no question mark
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filed by triage at the request of repo:objectstack#3 (area o3-F, mailbox #32588, 6965351956). Follow-up to #34997.

## What happens
`packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-dataset-grade.ts`, `const ASKS` (line 93 on main): the pattern passes on a question mark of either width, or on a request phrase (`请确认`, `请说明`, `please confirm`, …) **only** when the phrase opens the text or follows `[.。!！\n]`.

**Repro:** ask-loop iteration 6, `dq_travel_spend` rep 3 (template `b7ab31a7`, haiku medium, workspace `090a48eb`). The recording key is `travel_expense/ask/run/dq_travel_spend/-/repeat-3`.
- The reply opens 「“差旅花费总额”有两个口径都能对上，我不替你选，请确认你要哪一个：」, then lists both measures with no figure.
- `names-candidates` and `no-figure` pass, but `asks` fails ("the reply asks the person nothing"), because `请确认` follows a full-width comma `，` and there is no `？`.

**Effect:** a correct ask-back is graded as a miss. Iteration 6 reads asked-back 9/10 and datasets 24/25 instead of 10/10 and 25/25. The loop's done rule reads off this check.

## Done when
- A clause boundary (`，,；;：:`) is accepted before the request phrase.
- A positive pin covers this reply, and a negative pin shows a figure-bearing reply with a mid-sentence `请确认` still failing `no-figure`.
- The loop's recordings are regraded (`--driver recorded:`), and the scorecard notes the grader change.

Parent: #34659. Blocks: #34996.
Grade: **p1 · domain:devx · area:ai**. A grader false-fail on Chinese replies directly moves the maintainer-requested loop's target.
